BTC 5m Up/Down Nowcast Engine

G1 · DATA MATCH ACTIVE TRADING DISABLED

Objective

Calibrated p_up that BTC 5-minute market btc-updown-5m-<epoch> resolves Up, measured against market price q_up after fees. Research & measurement only — no order execution.

Target: Chainlink 60s TWAP. S_open = opening TWAP, S_end = settlement TWAP. Up if S_end ≥ S_open (tie rule read per market).

G1 pipeline (record → match)

Gamma (metadata, outcome) ─┐
PolyBolt (TWAP + spot) ────┴→ Raw Store (Parquet) → Matcher → Report
StepCommand
1. record 1hpolybolt_ws --duration-sec 3600
2. metadatagamma --slug btc-updown-5m-<epoch>
3. matchg1_match --raw data/raw --gamma data/gamma

Gates (spec v2.3)

GateRequirementStatus
G1 Datacomputed outcome = official, all windowsACTIVE
G2 Modelbeat B1/B2 walk-forwardGATED
G3 Marketbeat q_up + net edge after feeGATED
G4 Shadow2+ weeks live, no ordersGATED
G5 Executedesigned separately after G1–G4GATED

Data sources

SourceRole
price.crypto.twap btcusd/60official TWAP (label)

Gamma APIrules, window, outcome

Fee (taker, crypto): 0.07 · p · (1−p) per share, 5dp, min 0.00001 USDC.

Run it

pip install -r nowcast/requirements.txt
python -m nowcast.run.live --step record --duration-sec 3600
python -m nowcast.ingest.gamma --slug btc-updown-5m-<epoch> --out data/gamma
python -m nowcast.eval.g1_match --raw data/raw --gamma data/gamma --out data/reports
pytest nowcast/tests -q
